name: KINS 3531W
title: Scientific Writing in Aerobic Training for Health and Performance
description: A writing intensive class integrated with course content in KINS 3530.
requirement_description: KINS 4500; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open only to students in Kinesiology programs, others by consent of instructor. Corequisite: KINS 3530. Not open for credit to students who have passed KINS 3530W.
